metaTitle: Custom Steel Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom steel badge ID holders for durable, professional access control. Perfect for bulk corporate orders.
introHtml: Steel badge ID holders offer unmatched durability for high-traffic environments like factories, hospitals, and corporate campuses. Unlike plastic or fabric alternatives, steel resists bending, scratching, and wear, making it ideal for long-term use with frequent scanning or swiping. Choose from brushed or polished finishes, and add your logo via laser engraving for a permanent, professional look that stands up to daily abuse.
heroAltText: Custom steel badge ID holders with brushed finish and laser-engraved logo on lanyard
